    import ctypes
import numpy as np

gslcblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

class GSLMatrix(object):
    def __init__(self, rows, cols):
        self.rows = rows
        self.cols = cols
        self.matrix = None
     
    def alloc(self):
        if self.matrix is not None:
            raise Exception("GSL Matrix already allocated")
        self.matrix = gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc(self.rows, self.cols)
     
    def free(self):
        if self.matrix is None:
            raise Exception("GSL Matrix already freed")
        gsl.gsl_matrix_free(self.matrix)
        self.matrix = None
     
    def numpy_to_gsl_matrix(self, np_array):
        assert isinstance(np_array, np.ndarray), "numpy array expected"
        if self.matrix is not None:
            raise Exception("GSL Matrix already allocated")
        self.rows = np_array.shape[0]
        self.cols = np_array.shape[1]
        self.matrix = gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc(self.rows, self.cols)
        for i in range(self.rows):
            for j in range(self.cols):
                self.matrix[i,j] = np_array[i,j]
     
    def gsl_matrix_to_numpy(self):
        assert isinstance(self.matrix, ctypes.c_void_p), "GSL Matrix not allocated"
        numpy_array = np.empty((self.rows, self.cols))
        for i in range(self.rows):
            for j in range(self.cols):
                numpy_array[i,j] = self.matrix[i,j]
        return numpy_array
     
    def __del__(self):
        if self.matrix is not None:
            self.free()

def gsl_multifit_covar(jacobian, epsrel):
    assert isinstance(jacobian, GSLMatrix), "GSL Matrix expected"
    assert isinstance(epsrel, float), "float expected"
     
    # Allocate covariance matrix
    cov = GSLMatrix(jacobian.rows - 1, jacobian.cols)
    cov.alloc()
     
    # Compute covariance matrix
    gsl.gsl_multifit_covar(jacobian.matrix, epsrel, cov.matrix)
     
    # Return covariance matrix
    return cov.gsl_matrix_to_numpy()
